geometry_basis: Same geometry family as the resident Instruct session: four decoder-only 24576-token slots under c98304 np4, q8_0 KV, mmproj-free decode over pre-materialised speech packets. ONLY the model (the Thinking GGUF), its own packet root (the audio-encoder tensors of the two mmproj files differ, so the Instruct packets are not valid input), the completion cap (8192 tokens, amended from 2048 at the decode-cost sign-off: a thinking completion is long and one smoke row spent its whole 2048 budget on reasoning; the direct-only prompt is about 2.3k tokens, so 2.3k + 8192 is 43 percent of a 24576-token slot) and the reasoning flag (--reasoning-format deepseek: thoughts go to message.reasoning_content, which the transport never reads, and never into message.content) differ. Owner decision 266-E admits this model for one bare-core read and nothing else.
